task.title: Create a workspace
task.shortdesc: Start a new, empty family tree and give it a name.

context.p: A workspace is one family tree and everything kept with it. You can have more than one. Make a new one for each tree you start.
context.note: Do not give your new tree the name of a tree you removed in the same session. The new tree mixes up its data with the old one until you close and open it again.

info.p: The picture shows the page when no tree is open. It has the buttons and .

stepresult.p: A small box named opens. It says Name your new family tree. The name box already holds the words My family tree.

step.cmd: Clear the words in the name box. Type a name of your own, such as My family.

info.p: Clear the box first, so that the name you type is the whole name.

stepresult.p: Your new tree opens on . It says 0 persons · 0 families · 0 events. A button named is ready.

result.p: You have an empty tree with a name of your own. saves your changes as you go.
If you want to use the name of a tree you removed, remove that tree first. Close , open it again, and only then create the new tree. says more, and says what to do about a tree called default.
